title: Football Chronicle
subtitle: Football management, thoughtfully simplified
description: An independent football management game focused on meaningful decisions, memorable player careers and seasons that move at a satisfying pace.
body:
Football Chronicle explores a more streamlined approach to football management.

## The idea

Make the important choices matter, without forcing players to spend hours navigating menus. Player histories, clubs and developing careers should still feel personal.

## Current focus

- Faster matchday flow and season progression
- More individual player profiles and histories
- Distinct club identities and crests

The portfolio can be updated with actual game screenshots as development continues.
